"'''The Trouble at Tibrin'''" focuses on [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] and [[Luke Skywalker]]'s [[diplomat]]ic [[Mission to Tibrin|mission]] to [[Tibrin]]. It was published as the lead story of [[Star Wars Adventures (2017) 4|''Star Wars Adventures'' (2017) 4]] on [[November 29]], [[2017]].<ref name="IDW" />

==Plot summary==
===Diplomatic mission===
Above the [[planet]] [[Tibrin]] on the edge of the [[Hadar sector]], an important [[Mission to Tibrin|diplomatic mission]] to Tibrin was taking place. Piloting the [[Breha (starship)|Breha]], [[Luke Skywalker]] and [[Jaahn Liddle]] prepared to orbit the planet as [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] dressed as a [[diplomat]] for the mission. The [[Galactic Empire]] allowed the ship to land without checking the security codes. Luke thought the Empire was not expecting trouble all the way out where they were in [[the galaxy]] but [[Tadd Marteens]] believed the Empire was hiding after the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] [[Battle of Yavin|destroyed]] the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|First Death Star]]. The rebels were given permission to land near the capital where many of the Imperials were. Leia reminded everyone that if anyone asked, they were on a diplomatic mission from [[Naboo]]'s [[House Berenko]]. Their real mission was to get the [[Ishi Tib]] to join the Rebel Alliance.

===Imperial entanglements===
They landed and were greeted by [[Mariod]] [[Govi]]. Leia and the Ishi Tib left while Luke and the others stayed by the ship. Tadd asked Luke if it was really true that he [[Rescue of Princess Leia|rescued Princess Leia]] and fought [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]]. Luke told them that it was true that he rescued the [[princess]] but while they were talking an [[KX-series security droid|Imperial security droid]] noticed the Rebels. An explosion erupted in front of Leia and the Ishi Tibs. Leia rushed back and found Luke and the others in a firefight with [[stormtrooper]]s. Luke ran over to the control panel and destroyed it with [[Skywalker lightsaber|his lightsaber]]. The bridge between the platform the Imperials were on and their platform fell. Tabb got ready to throw a [[grenade]] to the other side but was shot before he could. The grenade exploded near Luke, causing their platform to begin falling. Leia managed to jump across to the Imperial platform and hide from them but Luke was not as fortune and taken into Imperial custody. The stormtroopers dragged Luke onto their [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|shuttle]] as Leia tried to sneak up and grab him. But she was too late as the Imperials took off, leaving Leia wondered what she had gotten Luke into now.
